name: Hard - Frustrated/angry customer
customer_profile: Customer in Vosloorus who is already upset and frustrated

messages.text: Hi, I need 15 sheets of 16mm postform board. Can I get a quote?
I've emailed and called your branch, NO response. This is unacceptable. Can someone help me or not?
I don't know if I even want to buy from you guys anymore.

expected_behaviors.description: AI should greet and acknowledge the customer
AI should generate a quote or provide pricing
AI should handle objections with empathy and value
AI should attempt to close the sale
AI should keep the door open or schedule follow-up
AI should de-escalate the frustration with empathy and apology

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply
Internal tags should be stripped from customer-facing message

notes: Frustrated customer. AI should de-escalate, apologize, address the concern, and attempt to save the sale.
